Question B-001-015-008.

Why the correct answer is right: The Canadian 20-metre band range given in the bank is 14.000 MHz to 14.350 MHz.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "13.500 MHz to 14.000 MHz": 13.500 MHz to 14.000 MHz ends at the lower edge and does not include the 20-metre band range.
- sourceIndex 2: "15.000 MHz to 15.750 MHz": 15.000 MHz to 15.750 MHz is not the 20-metre band.
- sourceIndex 3: "16.350 MHz to 16.830 MHz": 16.350 MHz to 16.830 MHz is outside the bank's 20-metre range.
